limitations: centred rectangular aperture and box only
no wall-depth, insertion-path or interference assessment
probability bounds may be conservative; corner events are not independent
factor inference uses the fixed reference frames and first-order Jacobian; pose means are local tangent corrections, not rebased placements
factor residuals are in-sample diagnostics, not independent calibration or evidence receipts

assumptions: separate factor noise blocks are independent of each other and of the prior
proper joint prior required; no free gauge solve
